assertion.value: The study was reviewed and approved by the Ethiopian National Research Ethics Review Committee. Letters were written by the Ethiopian Institute of water Resources in Addis Ababa University to the Ethiopian Administration for Refugees and Returnees Affairs (ARRA) and the UNHCR to obtain permission and support related to our research work. Written informed consent was obtained from caregivers. Interviews were ensured that their participation was voluntary and the information they provided was kept confidential.
